messages:
emma.peopleops: Heads-up  found a small weathered wooden crate and a bundle of visitor lanyards at the side delivery door by the bike rack. Crate label reads 'Prototype - Do not open'. No courier note. Key is a tiny blue plastic fob taped to the crate. Can someone bring the dolly? :package: :bicycle:
carlos: I can grab the dolly in 10. Where do you want it stored?
riley: If it's fragile let's put it in Staging C (back room under the stairs). Also FYI I moved three folding chairs to Confroom B earlier  they're still there.
emma.peopleops: Staging C works. Also we have a 09:45 visitor listed as 'Design Partners'  host is @zoe. Can we pre-print a visitor badge and mark lanyards 'design-only'?
frontdesk-bot: Automated: Visitor badge request queue shows 1 pending for 09:45 (host: zoe). Pre-print option: YES.
zoe: Approving pre-print  front desk please set access to 'visitor - observe only'.
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: BadgeID 9510. Placed in Drawer A3. Lanyard tag created: DESIGN-PARTNERS.
carlos: Dolly + crate moved to Staging C. Blue fob peeled off and placed in Envelope 'fob-2134' in Drawer A3. Chairs still in Confroom B. Photo: https://files.redwood/wood-crate.jpg
riley: Wiped a little soil and cleaned a scuff on the tile near the side door. Tagged crate STORED-2134.
emma.peopleops: Thanks team  I'll update the delivery ledger and ping the host group. If no claim after 48h we'll return to shipper. Coffee for the 8:30 sweep volunteer. :coffee:
zoe: I'll do the 8:30 sweep and bring a travel mug. Quick reminder to hosts: please request early access if you need prototypes moved before sign-in.
carlos: Got it, see you morning Zoe.
